decision: Repeat the exact AWQ compatibility/determinism smoke only after correcting the independently measured cold-JIT scheduler-watchdog mismatch.

causal_hypothesis.primary: Raising SGLang's scheduler watchdog from its 300-second default to 1,800 seconds will allow the measured cold L40S sm_89 Marlin JIT sequence to finish, after which the already full-loaded GLM-specific AWQ path will reach health and two exact-identical greedy completions.
causal_hypothesis.stock_control: V14 on the identical checkpoint, runtime, patch, GPU class, and workload loaded all four shards in 18.25 seconds at 17.36 GB model memory, then fired the default watchdog during the second active JIT specialization before health.
causal_hypothesis.expected_direction: Cold compile completes within 1,800 seconds; health and both deterministic requests pass.
causal_hypothesis.falsification_value: A loader/output failure after compilation rejects the patch semantics; compile beyond 1,800 seconds rejects this cold-serving geometry; preemption remains infrastructure evidence only.
